source: 2026-11-06 T259 (gameplay-programmer): structure of the Star Bazaar win (design/proposals/2026-11-06-empire-growth-v2.md section 4). No numbers here: every number is a data/balance.json key named below, PLACEHOLDER until economy-designer sets it.

rules.bill_goods: goods of the run's branch market with that goods.json tier, any mix; energy is not part of a bill
rules.bill_where: the capital's planet storage; the bill is removed when the stage completes at cycle end
rules.quorum: other worlds (not the capital) at that prosperity tier or more
rules.reach: from bazaar_reach_stage a world of the quorum stands in another system than the capital
